platforms.title: Supported Platforms
platforms.subtitle: Support depends on what each platform currently allows. Capabilities below reflect what this build can actually do.

platforms.trademarks: All product names, logos, and brands are property of their respective owners. ClipFlow is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any of these platforms; their marks are shown only to identify which services a link may come from.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: The short answers.
faq.a1: The list on the Supported Platforms page reflects what this build can process today. Support depends on each platform's availability and current technical restrictions, so a platform marked Limited may refuse a link at any time.
faq.a2: No. ClipFlow only processes publicly accessible content that the source platform permits. It never signs in, bypasses paywalls, defeats DRM, or works around access restrictions.
faq.a3: Formats come from the media the source actually returns, filtered by what this server can produce. If a quality is not listed, the source does not offer it.
faq.q4: Do files stay on the server?
faq.a4: No. Processed files live in temporary storage with an expiry timer and are deleted automatically. Download links stop working once they expire.
faq.a5: Yes. The whole flow — paste, analyze, choose, download — is designed for touch and small screens first.

legal.notice: Only download content you have permission to save or that the source platform allows you to download. Respect copyright, privacy, and platform rules.
legal.responsibleLead: ClipFlow is a media utility, not a way around anyone's rules.
legal.responsibleBody: It processes publicly accessible media where the source platform permits it. It does not bypass DRM, authentication, paywalls, private-content restrictions, or platform security. When a platform refuses a request, ClipFlow reports that plainly instead of trying another way in.
legal.yourResponsibility: You are responsible for what you download
legal.yourResponsibilityBody: Copyright, privacy law, and each platform's terms still apply to you. Download your own content, content you have permission to save, or content whose licence allows it.

settings.subtitle: Preferences are stored in this browser only.

settings.rememberLastDesc: Reuse the format and quality you picked last time.
settings.privacyDesc: Nothing here leaves your browser except the links you analyze.
settings.clearHistoryDesc: Removes the local list and asks the server to delete your temporary files.

settings.privacyInfo: ClipFlow stores no account, no email, and no download history on the server beyond the temporary file needed to hand you the download.
